current_role: Serving a 20-year federal sentence for sex trafficking (Federal Prison Camp Bryan, Texas)
summary: Ghislaine Maxwell, the youngest child of British media owner Robert Maxwell, was Jeffrey Epstein’s longtime companion and associate. A federal jury convicted her in December 2021 of sex trafficking minors for Epstein, and she was sentenced to 20 years in June 2022. After Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche interviewed her in July 2025 she was moved to a minimum-security camp; a judge rejected her bid to overturn her conviction in August 2026, and the Senate unanimously opposed any pardon in July 2026.
